signing.keyStorage: secure CI secret; never commit keystore or passwords

notes: The OmegA package must install alongside the original Via Browser and must not overwrite it.
The Android application ID is distinct from the Java/Kotlin namespace; do not rename mark.via.* code packages unless required by verified runtime references.
Review and migrate manifest authorities, custom permissions, deep links, shortcuts, widgets, and any hard-coded package-ID references during APK repackaging.
Keep the original minimum SDK for compatibility unless later testing proves a safe change is needed.
The package ID and label are the approved build targets; apply them during the APK rebuild/signing stage.
